## 1. The source and the actual receiver

Take a source qubit \(S\) with fixed dynamics

\[
H_S=\frac{\Omega}{2}X,\qquad
L_S=\sqrt{\gamma}\,Z,
\]

so that

\[
\dot\rho=-i[H_S,\rho]+\gamma\mathcal D[Z]\rho,
\qquad
\mathcal D[L]\rho=L\rho L^\dagger-\frac12\{L^\dagger L,\rho\}.
\]

The physical premise is a **coherent traveling measurement field, before irreversible amplification**, with vacuum input. A fraction \(\eta\) reaches the receiver; the rest is inaccessible. A dephasing master equation alone does not supply this interface.

Bob has two qubits, initially \(|00\rangle\). Receiver 1 couples to the field during \([0,h]\); receiver 2 couples during \([h,2h]\), where

\[
h=\frac{\pi}{2\Omega},\qquad T=\frac{\pi}{\Omega}.
\]

The inactive receiver stores its state. Each active receiver has lowering coupling \(R_j=\sqrt{\kappa}\,\sigma^-_j\); set \(\kappa=\Omega\).

This is a genuine forward cascade. With \(C=\sqrt{\eta\gamma}\,Z_S\), its joint generator during window \(j\) is

\[
\mathcal G_j(\rho)=
-i\left[
H_S+\frac{R_j^\dagger C-C^\dagger R_j}{2i},\rho
\right]
+\mathcal D[C+R_j]\rho
+(1-\eta)\gamma\mathcal D[Z_S]\rho .
\]

The cross Hamiltonian is the standard cascaded interaction, not an additional direct source–receiver gate. The source marginal retains its specified dynamics. Continuous quantum decoders use this same input–output formalism. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}

After \(T\), Bob applies local filters and a two-qubit decoding unitary. An optional photon counter monitors the field **after** the receivers. The original source is discarded without measurement.

The ideal model also assumes cold receiver initialization, calibrated phases and couplings, and accurate local gates and storage. Their physical costs enter the unresolved operation below.
